coding_context.description: Infants pointed selectively in the mistaken action con-dition, when the adult had the goal of retrieving the object but an incorrect representation about its location. Importantly, infants provided the new information only when it was relevant to the combination of both the adult’s prior goal representation and her representation of reality.
